MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The nut-and-bolt thread gauge felt useful because it could help me identify and match pieces from my recent hardware assortment, provided it supports metric sizes.",
    "The rubber grommet assortment fits my interest in assorted small hardware, but I would wait until I have a wiring project before choosing it."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The SAE thread checker and inch-sized bolts miss the metric sizes in my recent screw assortment; a related purpose alone does not make them usable for my current needs.",
    "Battery protector, an abrasive brush, sealant, a printer extruder, and an inspection camera each require a specific task I have not shown a need for.",
    "Buying magnetic hooks does not mean I own a pegboard, so peg locks do not follow naturally from those purchases."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases seem to have been treated as broad interest in workshop supplies, although I only interact when something serves a relevant purpose.",
    "Assorted hardware and fastening products seem to have been treated as interchangeable despite differences in size, compatibility, and intended use."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The explicit M3, M4, and M5 metric sizes in my recent assortment matter when suggesting matching hardware or measuring tools.",
    "A tool that helps me use hardware I already bought is more immediately useful than equipment for an unrelated project.",
    "Something can fit my interests without being something I need now, as with the grommet assortment."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in practical hardware but stretched it into unrelated projects and overlooked metric compatibility and immediate need."
}
